_comment: Hand-authored demo robot observations. Everything in this file is synthetic:
no robot has driven Homewood yet. It exists so the verification pipeline has
something to show — hazard markers, evidence photos, 'Avoid this obstacle',
the approaching-hazard alert, and a non-zero verified percentage.
Each observation is placed by coordinate, and the seed builder snaps it onto
the nearest real pathway segment. That keeps it anchored to JHU's actual
network rather than to a parallel set of invented nodes, so deleting this
file degrades the demo without breaking routing.
The measurements below are the only slope/roughness/surface/lighting values
anywhere in the graph. Every other segment leaves them null, because nobody
has measured them. Replace these with real runs as they come in.

observations.title: Uneven brick paving
observations.description: Several raised bricks can catch small wheels near Levering Hall.

observations.title: Limited nighttime lighting
observations.description: Lighting is sparse on the eastern recreation-center path.

observations.title: Unmarked step at the quad edge
observations.description: A single riser where the Decker Quad path meets the pavement, easy to miss at night.
